title: The Rangers Answer
summary: The player hurt or killed someone in the country where Captain Renna Thorne and the King's Rangers are riding. If Renna knows it, she answers by her own soul: bring the stranger in under crown law, warn them, look away, or take their side.

hooks.situation: The King's Rangers ride as the crown's law on these roads, and {player} broke the peace where they ride: {event.summary}. Word has reached the captain, and people are watching what the Rangers do.

options.label: Bring the stranger in under crown law

effects.text: Find {player} and bring them in to answer under crown law, with two riders and no rope.

options.label: Give them one warning, under the crown's name

effects.text: Tell {player} the Rangers know what they did, that the crown's law rides these roads, and that there will be no second warning.

options.label: Let it pass; the Rangers have the Hollow to answer for first
Side with the stranger: {victim} had it coming

effects.text: Tell {player} that {victim} had it coming, and that the Rangers won't be asking about it.
